name: adopt-alb-services
description: Onboarding: a bespoke multi-service ALB pipeline adopted as build.json components run by one generic driver — no per-service pipelines, no describe-stacks|jq glue.

scripts.build: chant build src/shared-alb --lexicon aws -o dist/shared-alb.template.json && chant build src/api --lexicon aws -o dist/api.template.json && chant build src/ui --lexicon aws -o dist/ui.template.json
scripts.teardown: aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name api; aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name ui; aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name shared-alb
